title: A Ternary Cognitive Space for Literary Structure: Mapping, Fingerprinting, and Replication
description: Formal framework: a ternary cognitive space (T/S/C axes x 9 dimensions x 3 states = 3^9 = 19,683 cells) for reproducible literary structure analysis. Complete annotation of the 120-chapter public-domain *Dream of the Red Chamber* yields 84 unique codes with fingerprint entropy H=1.3929 (uniform bound log2(3)=1.58496), triad entropies T/S/C=1.4143/1.1550/1.5056 and structural center (0,0,0) interpreted as 'daily-life tragedy'. Reliability: mean Cohen's kappa=0.477 over 15 stratified chapters. Discriminative control: zero cross-corpus matches vs *Romance of the Three Kingdoms* (ch.1-10) and *One Hundred Years of Solitude* (ch.1, translated; no copyrighted text redistributed). Reverse replication: 40-node mirror blueprint reproduced 40/40 at zero Hamming distance. Open-source CLI (tri9cog, MIT) and reproducible benchmark data included. Chinese abstract is appended in the paper metadata section.
